import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1]
    
    count = 0
    max_val = 0
    start = -1
    in_parentheses = False
    
    for i in range(len(s)):
        if s[i] == '_':
            if start != i - 1:
                if in_parentheses:
                    count += 1
                else:
                    max_val = max(max_val, i - 1 - start)
            start = i
        elif s[i] == '(':
            in_parentheses = True
            if start != i - 1:
                max_val = max(max_val, i - 1 - start)
            start = i
        elif s[i] == ')':
            in_parentheses = False
            if start != i - 1:
                count += 1
            start = i
    
    if start != len(s) - 1:
        max_val = max(max_val, len(s) - 1 - start)
    
    print(f"{max_val} {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
